children: Willis Lease Finance presented its integrated aviation platform and $4.4B in managed assets at Deutsche Bank’s Aviation Forum.
Austin C. Willis, CEO, presented Willis Lease Finance’s strategy and platform at Deutsche Bank’s 16th Annual Aviation Forum.
Company furnished a presentation (Exhibit 99.1) under Item 7.01; content is furnished, not filed under SEC rules.
Presentation emphasizes Willis Platform services, integrated MRO, asset management and leasing capabilities across 120 countries.
Reports $4.4B AUM (as of 6/30/2026) and highlights joint-venture and institutional capital growth opportunities.
Presentation contains forward-looking statements and non-GAAP metrics; risks and reconciliations referenced within the slides.
